answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting Rule.** Each identity’s interaction graph is hashed into a rolling fingerprint, weighted like quartz for stability across epochs. At epoch close, an identity must match its own prior fingerprint within a tolerance band; a sudden shift toward another cluster is flagged as a possible oasis of shared control. The agent must then submit fresh, costly proof-of-work tied to its historical pigment of activity patterns.
